# Tadalafil

**Authors:** George Fahmy, Jaclyn Hess

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

This program discusses the clinical applications of tadalafil, a potent phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitor. This drug has received FDA approval for the management of erectile dysfunction (ED), benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), and pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). This activity explores the indications, contraindications, and mechanisms of action of tadalafil. Participants will gain comprehensive insights into its administration protocols, potential adverse drug reactions, drug interactions, toxicity profile, monitoring parameters, and box warnings.
